lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 added exit-status guards to runShipBump: (addResult.status ?? 1) !== 0 and (commitResult.status ?? 1) !== 0, plus printError + throw on failure. Imported printError from src/logging/color.ts. Added 3 new tests covering the failure paths. Next is US-R1-002: wire writeEvent in production _buildBumpOpts in index.ts so the structured ShipBumpResult event is actually appended to .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl on real cam ship --bump invocations.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: spawnSync returns { status: number | null } and does NOT throw on non-zero exit. status is null when the child terminates via signal. Our (result.status ?? 1) !== 0 guard correctly handles both cases.
